en: The postcard consists of two sides. The image side features a vintage black-and-white photograph of a street lined with elegant buildings and trees, captioned 'Schloss-Strasse.' in red at the top. A handwritten message in German, dated 5. Juli 1898, fills the lower portion. Printed text on the left margin reads 'Verlag von Ferd. Pietsch, Pyrmont.' The reverse side is formatted for mailing, contains a green German stamp stamped 'PYRMONT', and is addressed to 'Fräulein Else Mehring' in Berlin, Renzlauerallee 6, with additional official and museum stamps.
